About This App
 
 Welcome to Find Your Flower app, a project developed for my dissertation. This app enables you to identify and classify a variety of 102 flowers commonly found across the United Kingdom, using state-of-the-art machine learning models.
 
 How to Use:
 
 1.Select Model: Pick a model (MobileNet or VGG) to begin the prediction process.
 
 2. Capture Image: Use your device's camera to capture an image of a flower or choose an existing image from your gallery.
 
 3. Predict Flower: Our chosen model will analyze the image and provide a prediction for the flower's species.
 
 Contact:
 
 For inquiries or feedback, reach out at lp.mscdissertation@gmail.com.

 Thank you for using FindYourFlower!
